detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.summary: This cycle updates the project identity and maintains the research trajectory on autonomous identification of research gaps in open-ended learning, using collected evidence to evaluate intrinsic motivation and curiosity-driven frameworks.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Maintaining active inquiry into autonomous gap identification.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: How does accumulated path-dependent experience shape emergent preferences in adaptive agents?
detail.reason: Maintaining active inquiry into preference formation mechanisms.
